snippet.title: What Does the Bible Say About Depression?
snippet.description: Depression has seemed to always have a stigma attached to it, especially in the church. But in this story we see Elijah go from Rockstar status to crippled by depression almost instantly. In this message, we'll look at six things we can learn from Elijah.
